title: Apple will stream Friday Night Baseball live in Vision Pro
excerpt: Games will stream every Friday for four weeks
content_html:
David Imel

is a technology reporter who has been covering the industry since 2007. He co-hosts the Waveform podcast with MKBHD. A former engineer, he now specializes in topics like computational photography and social media protocols.

Starting on Friday, August 28th, Apple will begin streaming Friday Night Baseball in immersive video on Apple Vision Pro. The stream will feature commentary from various analysts and reporters, and live graphics will be anchored around the viewers space during the game. After the games conclude, replays will be made available in the Apple TV app.

Last year, Apple streamed a selection of live Lakers NBA games to the headset, hoping to entice basketball fans. Baseball adds to its library of immersive content users are able to access on Vision Pro, which also includes immersive content like parkour across Paris and an Alicia Keys rehearsal.

The first Friday Night Baseball matchup will be Boston Red Sox at New York Yankees, and the streams will span through September 18th.

content_html_zh:
大卫·伊梅尔

是一名科技记者，自2007年以来一直报道该行业。 他与 MKBHD 共同主持波形播客。 他曾是一名工程师，现在专注于计算摄影和社交媒体协议等主题。

从 8 月 28 日星期五开始，Apple 将开始在 Apple Vision Pro 上以沉浸式视频形式播放《周五棒球之夜》。 该直播将包括来自不同分析师和记者的评论，比赛期间现场图像将固定在观众空间周围。 比赛结束后，Apple TV 应用程序将提供重播。

去年，苹果公司通过耳机直播了一系列湖人队 NBA 比赛直播，希望能够吸引篮球迷。 Baseball 增加了用户可以在 Vision Pro 上访问的沉浸式内容库，其中还包括沉浸式内容，例如巴黎跑酷和艾丽西亚·凯斯 (Alicia Keys) 排练。

周五晚上的第一场棒球比赛将是波士顿红袜队 (Boston Red Sox) 对阵纽约洋基队 (New York Yankees)，直播将持续到 9 月 18 日。

Apple
